python3 -c "
import xarray as xr
import numpy as np
arr = xr.DataArray(
     np.arange(3),
     coords=[('x', [0, 1, 2])],
 )
data = xr.Dataset({'a': arr, 'b': arr})
stacked = data.to_stacked_array('y', sample_dims=['x'])
print(stacked)
print(stacked.indexes['y'])
sel = stacked.sel(variable='a').squeeze(drop=True)
print(sel)
print(sel.coords)
"
